topic: Choose a location for a neighborhood book swap

scenario.topic: Choose a location for a neighborhood book swap
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when picking a spot for our neighborhood book swap — easy access, weather protection, or community vibe?

options.name: Maple Street Community Garden Pavilion
options.upside: Provides shelter from rain and sun, encouraging year-round use.
options.tradeoff: Less foot traffic on weekdays, so fewer spontaneous visitors.
options.concern: Limited parking nearby may deter some neighbors from driving over.

options.name: Corner of Elm and 5th Street Sidewalk
options.upside: Maximum visibility and foot traffic, likely to attract many casual browsers.
options.tradeoff: No shelter means books and visitors are exposed to weather elements.
options.concern: Noise and traffic may make the area less inviting for longer browsing.

options.name: Westside Public Library Front Lawn

attrs.weather_protection: partial (large trees provide shade but no rain cover)

options.upside: Close to an existing community hub, encouraging book lovers to stop by.
options.tradeoff: No solid shelter means books need extra protection on rainy days.
options.concern: Library hours limit supervision and security during evenings.
options.best_for: prioritizing community connection and moderate traffic

options.name: Sunset Park Playground Entrance

attrs.foot_traffic: moderate (families with children mostly afternoons and weekends)

options.upside: Attracts families and kids, encouraging a younger demographic to participate.
options.tradeoff: No shelter and playground noise may distract from browsing experience.
options.concern: Limited seating and no nearby lighting for evening use.
options.best_for: prioritizing family-friendly atmosphere and informal gathering

shared_context: The book swap will serve about 50 local families in a residential neighborhood.
The group deciding on the location consists of exactly 3 neighbors who want the swap to be accessible and inviting.
The swap is planned to run year-round, so weather protection and maintenance are important considerations.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara often carries books in unpredictable weather and values a sheltered spot to protect them.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the book swap location provides reliable weather protection so neighbors can browse comfortably year-round.

personas.name: Elif
personas.background: Elif enjoys lively social settings and prefers locations where many neighbors naturally pass by and interact.
personas.private_goal: To maximize visibility and foot traffic so the book swap attracts as many casual visitors as possible.

personas.name: Anton
personas.background: Anton is highly organized and prefers a location that balances accessibility with community connection.
personas.private_goal: To select a location that encourages community engagement while being practical and well-maintained.
